data.narrative:
Antora Energy is a Series C-stage climate & energy company that has raised $550M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 3 same-stage, same-sector comparables—KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy—reflecting a broader Climate & Energy universe of 9 private companies and 1 public comparable (Linamar, ticker LNZA).

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis applied a 1.7x step-up multiplier to the $550M total-raised proxy, implying a $935M valuation. Peer-median analysis across the 3-company comparable set yielded a median valuation of $1.0B, with peer valuations ranging from $700M (Amogy) to $3.0B (KoBold Metals). The wide dispersion reflects heterogeneous technology risk and commercialization timelines within the sector.

The two methods converge on a triangulated range of $795M to $1.1B, with a median of $968M. This midpoint reflects a modest premium to the $550M capital raised, consistent with Series C pricing momentum but conservative relative to the upper quartile of peer valuations. Key uncertainties include technology validation timelines for thermal storage systems, path to unit economics at scale, and funding environment sensitivity in climate tech. The valuation is most defensible within the $900M–$1.0B band, anchored by peer median comparables.
